stories.title: Wire Hono to the official tRPC Fetch adapter
acceptance: A real ephemeral Node HTTP server mounts a tRPC query and tracked SSE subscription through Hono using the official Fetch adapter
The in-memory DB-style store uses bounded catch-up pages and race-scoped publication cursors
The subscription registers its listener before capturing the high-water mark and preserves deterministic catch-up/live ordering
Focused wire tests prove query, content type, tracked cursor, event insertion during catch-up, duplicate suppression, and abort cleanup

stories.title: Drive the Vite client through a streaming proxy in Playwright
acceptance: Vite builds the browser client and an actual Chromium page connects with tRPC httpSubscriptionLink through a real reverse-proxy fixture
The proxy disables SSE buffering and preserves heartbeat/idle streaming headers
Browser reconnect resumes from the exact tracked cursor without gaps or duplicates
Browser unsubscribe aborts the server subscription and releases its listener

stories.title: Complete the transport resilience matrix and decision record
acceptance: Wire tests cover bounded queue overflow with resumable cursor, heartbeat/idle behavior, terminal error after headers, and proxy cleanup
npm run spike:transport starts all fixtures, drives the real browser, runs the complete matrix, and exits cleanly
The exact adapter/version matrix and observed evidence are recorded
ADR-0004 is accepted only if every named TASK-002 wire case passes
stories.verify: npm run spike:transport && npm run check
